messages:
incident-bot: Paging: [INC-2026-023] multiple Xid driver resets + ECC correctable count increasing on gpu-node-87 (region-us-west2). Auto-evac alert fired :rotating_light:

sre_jordan: acked. joining. seeing OOM and 'NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13' in dmesg. marking priority P1 if customer-facing.

leah: thanks. what's the impact? any model evictions?

micah: infra metrics show node GPU utilization fluctuating, several pods restarted with oom-kill on run-time-inference containers. tail of kubelet logs:
```
Apr 15 02:41:12 gpu-node-87 kubelet[1234]: Pod runtime-inference-xyz terminated: OOMKilled
Apr 15 02:41:12 gpu-node-87 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID=2145, in nvidia
Apr 15 02:41:14 gpu-node-87 mcelog: correctable ECC error on device 0000:65:00
```

oncall: @sre_jordan take it? I'm currently on a call.

sre_jordan: taking. quick runbook: cordon -> drain -> isolate GPU -> try nvidia-modprobe reload -> driver restart -> escalate to full node reboot if persistent. also open customer bridge if >10% request errors.

csm_raj: we're seeing elevated 5xxs for a subset of tenants (low-volume) in us-west2, some retries, but no mass outage yet. customers flagged two sessions. starting a bridge in 10 if we can't stabilize.

leah: starting rapid mitigation steps. micah, please scale up fallback pool (dedicated-fallback-inference) + increase autoscaler by +2 replicas. route policy: route 30% traffic to fallback for slow requests.

micah: scaling now. `kubectl scale deploy/dedicated-fallback-inference --replicas=5 -n infra`

infra-bot: autoscaler events: scaled from 3 -> 5 replicas in 18s.

sre_jordan: cordoning node: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-87`

ops: drain in progress: `kubectl drain gpu-node-87 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

eng-runtime: while drain runs, can we change model fallback to a smaller context length variant to reduce memory pressure? we have a canary model v2-small ready.

leah: toggling fallback routing rules (canary). updating LB weights.

sre_jordan: quick probe: `ssh gpu-node-87 sudo dmesg | tail -n 50` returns repeated lines:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, info: 0x38ef0000
[ 1234.568000] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed: -12
[ 1234.568100] nv-hostengine: Host Engine: gpu reset recovery
[ 1234.568200] EDAC MC0: CE page 0xXXXXX, syndrome 0x1
```

leah: Xid 13 + CE (correctable ECC) pattern. likely a driver-level recoverable fault but causing kvcache or allocator to blow up and trigger OOMs.

sre_jordan: attempted soft driver restart: `sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver.service` -> `Job for nvidia-driver.service failed because the control process exited with error code.` full log:
```
Apr 15 02:44:01 systemd[1]: Starting NVIDIA Driver Service...
Apr 15 02:44:02 nvidia-driver[9876]: failed to load kernel module nvidia_495
Apr 15 02:44:02 systemd[1]: nvidia-driver.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
```

micah: kubelet still reports containers restarting due to OOM on remaining GPUs. drain stalled because some pods have emptyDir and delete-local-data required.

sre_jordan: trying module unload/load:
```
sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia
sudo modprobe nvidia
```

ops: rmmod failing: "module in use" on nvidia_uvm. some pods still have handles.

leah: ok plan B: take node out of fleet (set node unschedulable already) and power-cycle the host via BMC. we'll avoid mid-driver manipulations while pods still hold handles. pre-announce reboot.

micah: BMC power-cycle scheduled, hitting power cycle now (ipmi -I lanplus -H 10.12.87.5 -U admin -P ***** chassis power cycle).

incident-bot: On-call handoff: @oncall stepping in at 02:50 UTC for continuity.

customer-bot: Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-023 (created). csm_raj added customer slack thread.

sre_jordan: host came back up after power-cycle. `dmesg` now shows fewer Xids but still one CE increment on GPU 0. reinstalled driver (rolled forward to 510.78) using package manager to avoid ABI mismatch.

eng-runtime: after reboot, nodes show healthy but one NV switch still flapping. we see model tail latency improved when routing to v2-small.

micah: now draining completed, pods rescheduled to fallback pool. no further OOMs for 12m.

leah: leaving node in quarantine: marking `gpu-node-87` with label `quarantine=cpu-only` and cordon-stay. we should also add automated eviction rule for nodes with >5 Xid within 10m. file ticket: INFRA-4289.

sre_jordan: opened INFRA-4289; added notes, attaching dmesg + driver logs.

csm_raj: customers on bridge: two low-volume tenants reported transient errors during the 6 minute window. we sent post-incident note. no SLA breach.

oncall: recommend follow-ups:
- full memory scan and stress test on gpu-node-87 hardware (ECC diagnostics)
- kernel and driver compatibility audit (we saw mixture of 495 & 510 remnants)
- automate graceful fallback routing for transient GPU faults
- implement a gating canary that auto-shifts 25% traffic to fallback if Xid rate > 3/min

ops: creating runbook PR with exact commands used + escalation tree.

sre_jordan: closing paging channel for now. leaving node quarantined and opening postmortem doc. tagging eng-runtime for model fallback improvements. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. If errors recur, incident-bot will re-open.
